These are **official free AI APIs** directly from the model creators. * * * ### [Google Gemini](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) 🇺🇸 [Permalink: Google Gemini 🇺🇸](https://github.com/amardeeplakshkar/awesome-free-llm-apis#google-gemini-) > Google's flagship model family. The free tier via AI Studio is among the most generous of any first-party provider. | Detail | Info | | --- | --- | | **Free Models** | Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Flash-8B, Gemini 1.0 Pro | | **Rate Limits** | 15 RPM / 1,500 RPD (Flash) · 2 RPM / 50 RPD (2.5 Pro) | | **OpenAI Compat** | ✅ Yes — `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/` | | **SDKs** | Python (`google-generativeai`), JS/TS, REST, Go, Swift, Dart | | **Speed Tier** | 🟢 Fast (Flash) · 🟡 Medium (Pro) | > ⚠️ Free tier not available in the EU, UK, or Switzerland. Apache 2.0 licensed models — free to use and self-host. Strong free tier for RAG and embedding use cases. | Detail | Info | | --- | --- | | **Free Models** | Command A, Command R+, Command R, Aya Expanse 32B, Aya Expanse 8B + 5 more | | **Rate Limits** | 20 RPM · 1,000 req/month | | **OpenAI Compat** | ⚠️ Partial — native SDK preferred (`cohere-python`) | | **SDKs** | Python (`cohere`), JS/TS (`cohere-ai`), Go, Java, REST | | **Speed Tier** | 🟡 Medium | * * * ### [Zhipu AI](https://open.bigmodel.cn/usercenter/apikeys) 🇨🇳 [Permalink: Zhipu AI 🇨🇳](https://github.com/amardeeplakshkar/awesome-free-llm-apis#zhipu-ai-) > Chinese AI lab.
